title: Ladder: motor start/stop with self-holding
summary: Draw the classic motor circuit as a ladder rung: a momentary Start contact with a self-holding branch through the contactor, a Stop contact and the overload relay contact in series, and a rung for the run lamp.
objectives: Build a self-holding rung with a parallel branch
Choose the contact type from the wiring: a normally closed Stop button reads TRUE while not pressed
Watch power flow through the rung online
instructions: The starter rung switches MotorContactor only while Start is held. Add a parallel branch with a normally open contact on MotorContactor so the coil holds itself.
Put a contact on StopPB in series. S2 is a normally closed button: StopPB is TRUE while Stop is NOT pressed, so the contact in the rung is normally open.
Put a normally open contact on OverloadOK in series: an overload trip makes it FALSE and opens the rung.
Add a second rung: MotorFeedback drives the RunLamp coil.
Load the program and watch the rung online: highlighted wires carry power in the scan the PLC just executed.
hints: Select the Start contact, choose Insert position Parallel and insert a normally open contact.
Select the parallel block, choose After, and insert the series contacts.
A normally closed contact on StopPB never passes power while S2 is released: the motor would never start.

criteria.title: Start energizes the contactor
criteria.onFail: MotorContactor did not switch on after StartPB became TRUE.

criteria.title: The motor keeps running after Start is released
criteria.onFail: The motor stopped when Start was released. Add a seal-in path through MotorContactor.

criteria.title: Stop de-energizes the contactor
criteria.onFail: The motor kept running after Stop was pressed. Remember: StopPB is FALSE while Stop is pressed.

criteria.title: Stop has priority over Start
criteria.onFail: The contactor switched on while Stop was held. Stop must always win.

criteria.title: An overload trip stops the motor
criteria.onFail: The contactor stayed energized after the overload relay tripped. Include OverloadOK in the logic.

criteria.title: The run lamp shows the running motor
criteria.onFail: The motor was running but RunLamp did not switch on.
